scenarios.title: Publish exact grade scale and draft gradebook
given: An approved offering needs Algebra grading with a 50 percent passing band and a points root.
Teacher has no grade-read delegation but may design the draft.
when: Registrar drafts/publishes the scale. Instructor sets two grade lines, previews synthetic scores, and registrar publishes the same digest.
then: 55/100 maps to Pass. Policy owns exactly one root and two leaf revisions.
Actual learner examples require separate read permission. Duplicate sibling order or overlapping bands blocks publication.

scenarios.title: Policy assignment activates atomically
given: Three active enrollments have policy revision 1. Two are in the approved adoption scope.
when: Stage revision 2 for two releases effective at 2026-08-01, then change one predecessor before activation.
Recompute and activate a fresh preview.
then: Stale batch changes neither enrollment. Fresh batch switches exactly two enrollments at the same boundary. Third remains on revision 1.

scenarios.title: Source evidence retries and out-of-order accepted corrections
given: Native attempt A earned 20/40 at sequence 2 and corrected 30/40 at sequence 3. Source checkpoints are complete.
when: Deliver E3 then E2 then repeat E3. Freeze coverage and calculate at a checkpoint including E3.
then: One current attempt score 3/4. E2 remains historical. No duplicate calculation on equal fingerprint.
Same tuple and conflicting lineage digest quarantines input and cannot change result.

scenarios.title: Confirmed missing stays distinct from submitted pending
given: One visible scored item is 8/10, one is excused, another 10-point item submitted and pending.
when: Calculate current and final. Then reconcile authenticated absence evidence for another identical learner without a submission.
then: First learner final pending, current 80 percent. Second learner final 8/20 after confirmed missing.
Learner explanation does not reveal staff-only sources.

scenarios.title: Exact ratio and impact modes produce distinct drops
given: A 50/50, B 65/100 and C 12/24 are counted under equal source validity.
when: Apply one drop in ratio mode and then separately sequential points impact mode.
then: Ratio drops C and computes 23/30. Impact drops B and computes 31/37. Neither rounds before threshold.

scenarios.title: Lateness and attempt choice keep raw evidence
given: Item maximum 40, raw 33 submitted 71 minutes after due, grace 10 and one point per commenced hour, capped 8. A second on-time attempt earned 30.
when: Calculate under highest and average approved policies.
then: First adjusts to 31 but raw source is unchanged. Highest is 31/40. Average is 61/80.

scenarios.title: Override conflict preserves released grade
given: Grade 74.20 was already released. New request proposes 77.00 against its base.
when: Accept a source correction to 76.00 before the override reviewer approves. Refresh request and approve.
then: Old request stale, fresh override computes 77.00 with 76.00 as computed lineage. Learner still sees 74.20 until correction release.

scenarios.title: Leased regrade preview has no partial official changes
given: Registrar selects 2 targets and new algorithm grade-calc-v2. One worker crashes after staging.
when: Retry expired lease with same input and complete preview. Change one target source before all-or-nothing apply.
then: No duplicate candidate. Apply rejects stale digest and neither pointer changes. Existing releases unaffected.

scenarios.title: Final release is atomic and can be withdrawn with audit
given: Two authorized overlapping staged manifests refer to same prior learner visibility pointer.
when: Activate A and then B. Withdraw A with recorded exposure reason.
then: A activates once, B rejects stale. Withdrawal revokes future learner access and leaves audit.

scenarios.title: Period closure and narrow correction window
given: 30 expected enrollments, 28 graded, 1 incomplete approved, 1 pending required.
when: Prepare close, approve remaining recognized disposition, close. Open a named correction window for one result, correct and reseal.
then: Initial close blocked. Final close keeps 30 dispositions. A different target fails authorization during correction.

scenarios.title: Appeal follows ownership boundaries
given: Learner released grade on May 4 and submits appeal May 12 under 14-day policy.
when: Assign independent reviewer and resolve changed only after approved correction release.
then: Original appeal pins first release. Item error corrected at source. Only public outcome text visible to learner.

scenarios.title: Report card staged, rendered, issued and corrected
given: A learner has two published interim grades and an approved comment, one additional staff-only comment.
when: Publish accessible template, stage and render report, issue, download, then void due to discovered source error.
then: Issued report includes only permitted comment, artifact hash stable after void, active verification reports void.

scenarios.title: Transcript captures GPA and supports restricted external disclosure
given: Algebra 3x4, History 4x3, Lab 2 pass/fail and Biology 3x0.
when: Issue transcript at cutoff, approve purpose-scoped destination and deliver. Later revoke future disclosure.
then: GPA 24/10 equals 2.40. Earned credits 9. No Lab GPA denominator. Retain earlier byte digest and deny future recipient download after revoke.

scenarios.title: Build versioned programme and admit a learner
given: Institutional unit conversion 1:1 and programme needs 12 total and 6 resident units.
when: Draft and publish credit scheme and exact programme rule graph, then admit learner under version 1.
then: Learner remains pinned to version 1 after version 2 is drafted. Duplicate active admission is blocked.

scenarios.title: Review recognized credit and separate waiver from award
given: Learner requests transfer Chemistry worth 3 units and a zero-credit prerequisite waiver.
when: Verify issuer and person. Independent registrar approves credit and exact waiver. Replay request.
then: Only one 3-unit transfer award, no GPA impact. Waived prerequisite grants zero credit.

scenarios.title: Overlapping elective pools need deterministic allocation
given: Group A accepts Astronomy or Chemistry. Group B accepts only Chemistry. Both need 3.
when: Evaluate same evidence twice and check search bounds.
then: Use Astronomy for A and Chemistry for B. 6 distinct units. Exact replay same fingerprint. Bound exhaustion returns needs_review without award.

scenarios.title: Competency corrected observation and renewal evidence
given: A level 3 day 10, B level 4 day 30. Two independent current level 3 observations required.
when: Correct B to level 2. Add independent C level 3 at day 40. Evaluate at day 40 and day 221.
then: Before C only one qualifying. Day 40 demonstrated, day 221 expired. Prior decisions preserved.

scenarios.title: Issue verifiable credential, then record revocation and renewal separately
given: Satisfied exact programme audit, approved opaque verification definition with only issuer and status visible.
when: Approve award, issue once despite retry, verify, revoke with authorized reason and try to reinstate revoked record.
then: Verification valid then revoked. Same issue retry returns same credential. Terminal revocation prevents reinstatement. New renewal may issue different ID.

scenarios.title: Analytics uses correct denominators and protected export
given: 40 eligible enrollments, 32 final pass/fail, 28 pass, 4 fail, 3 incomplete and 5 unresolved. One group contains 7 distinct persons.
when: Publish metric, generate cutoff snapshot and export, then revoke caller scope.
then: Pass rate 87.50 percent, finalized coverage 80.00 percent. Suppress small cell and companion cells as needed. Download after scope revocation denied.

scenarios.title: Early intervention uses complete source and human review
given: Learner has 2 confirmed overdue required tasks within 14 days and one optional task. Another learner has missing source checkpoint.
when: Run rule twice, assign case and dismiss after corrected due date.
then: Exactly one case. No case for incomplete data. No automatic learner notification or grade changes.

scenarios.title: Hidden grades do not leak through totals
given: Two 10-point grades exist, 9/10 released and 1/10 withheld.
when: Learner queries gradebook and requests staff-only revision explanation by ID.
then: Visible learner aggregate 90 percent, staff preview 50 percent. Private revision returns 404 and no evidence IDs.

scenarios.title: Substituted initial evidence cannot grant duplicate credits
given: Same equivalent local course passed twice at 3 units, grades 4.0 and 3.0. Default credits earliest pass and GPA all.
when: Audit and issue transcript snapshot from both approved sources.
then: Earned credits 3, GPA 3.50 with denominator 6. Both attempts visible according to profile.
